Business Development Manager Job at Romson Oil Field Services Limited




        
    

        
        Romson Oil Field Services Limited is an indigenous Nigerian oil and gas servicing firm founded in 1989 and operates as a prominent member of the Tropical General Investments (TGI) Group. The company delivers specialized engineering, maintenance, and chemical solutions across onshore, offshore, and deep-water environments.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Manager

Job Location: Rivers
Job type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	To drive sustainable business growth by identifying and securing new business opportunities, expanding market share, and building strong customer relationships within the oil and gas industry


Job Details


	Develop and implement business development strategies to achieve sales growth and expand market share.
	Identify and secure new business opportunities with oil and gas operators, EPC contractors, and service companies.
	Prepare and coordinate technical and commercial proposals, quotations, and tender submissions.
	Coordinate laboratory evaluations, bottle tests, field trials, and product qualification programs.
	Support the implementation and optimization of oilfield production chemicals, including demulsifiers, corrosion inhibitors, scale inhibitors, water clarifiers, biocides, H?S scavengers, oxygen scavengers, defoamers, and other specialty chemicals.
	Prepare annual sales budgets, revenue forecasts, and account development plans.
	Monitor market trends, customer requirements, competitor activities, and emerging technologies to identify business growth opportunities.
	Prepare and submit periodic business development, sales performance, and market intelligence reports to management.
	Ensure compliance with HSE policies, ISO standards, and company quality management requirements, maintaining all business documentation.
	Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor or management.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in chemical engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 8–12 years of experience in the oil and gas industry, including at least 5 years in business development, technical sales, or application support for oilfield production chemicals.
	An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is an added advantage.
	Strong technical knowledge of oilfield production chemistry, production and process systems, chemical injection systems, laboratory testing, field trial execution, and oil and gas production operations.
	Practical experience in the application and optimization of production chemicals, preferably with upstream oil and gas operators.
	Excellent business development, commercial negotiation, and technical presentation skills.
	Strong communication, interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
	Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
	Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications.
	Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
	Willingness to travel extensively to customer locations and OFFSHORE / ONSHORE field sites at short notice.
	Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by management.

Operations & Content Coordinator (Administrative Officer) Job at Wahala No Dey Finish




        
    

        
        Wahala No Dey Finish - Come Chop is a food content brand that focuses on creating engaging video content and high-quality visuals. They are active on platforms like YouTube and Facebook, showcasing food-related challenges and culinary showdowns, aiming to build an active and positive online community around their unique brand identity in the food content industry.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations & Content Coordinator (Administrative Officer)

Job Location: Lagos

Key Responsibilities
Team Coordination & Operations Management:
     

            
    




	Coordinate the daily activities of the Social Media Manager and Content Creator to ensure alignment with content plans and deadlines.
	Monitor team deliverables and ensure all staff complete assigned tasks on time.


Content Production Support:


	Participate in content shoots (both indoor and outdoor), assisting with logistics and execution.


Social Media & Content Oversight:


	Work closely with the Social Media Manager and Content Creator to ensure content is delivered and published as planned.


Administrative & Reporting Duties:


	Track team performance and task completion, providing regular updates to the Lead.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
